[[Forgotten Fan]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Wind Rider]]s in [[The Falls]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Illusion Magic]])
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +5
:Energy -5

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance and [[armor calculation#Categories|armor category]] of the inscription, it is possible to create a replica for this item with the same stats. Inscriptions on replicas provide core armor rather than bonus armor and are not limited by the bonus armor cap.
